name: popsicle
headline: WordPress AI SEO Prompts: Optimize Blog Posts
short_description: A complete collection of AI-ready prompts and workflows for creating high-quality, SEO-optimized WordPress blog posts. Includes YoastSEO optimization templates, keyword research guidance, content structure prompts, and on-page SEO checklists.
author: seljicom

sections.overview:
This skill provides structured AI prompts and workflows for writing, optimizing, and publishing SEO-friendly WordPress blog posts. It includes templates for YoastSEO optimization, meta title and description generation, internal linking strategies, and content structure guidance. The collection covers keyword research, competitive analysis, headline generation optimized for click-through rates, and schema markup assistance. Users get ready-to-use prompts for ChatGPT and GPT-4 integration with WordPress, plus markdown-to-WordPress formatting templates. This resource helps content creators maintain consistent formatting, improve readability scores, and achieve better search engine rankings while reducing time spent on content production.
Generate SEO-optimized blog post outlines with YoastSEO compliance
Create meta titles and descriptions for improved search visibility
Develop product review and tutorial content with internal linking
Conduct keyword clustering and competitive research for topics
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/seljicom/selji-wordpress-ai-seo-prompts`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a 1,000-word SEO-optimized blog post for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] about [TOPIC]. Include an introduction, 3-5 subsections with H2 headers, and a conclusion. Optimize for the primary keyword '[KEYWORD]' and 2-3 related secondary keywords. Follow YoastSEO best practices for readability, keyword density, and meta description.
```
Copy
